item.title: 🧸 New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years Gov. Hochul signed a law halting…
item.description: 🧸 New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years Gov. Hochul signed a law halting the manufacture, distribution and sale of toys with built-in chatbots. Think talking plushies, dolls and robots that chat with kids over the internet. It takes effect 90 days after signing, and the Senate and Assembly passed it with nearly unanimous support.

item.title: 🤖 Claude's MCP servers can now ship their own skills and run jobs in the backgr…
item.description: 🤖 Claude's MCP servers can now ship their own skills and run jobs in the background Anthropic put Skills over MCP in public beta , so a server delivers its playbook with its tools, and Claude loads it only when needed. Tasks and Elicitation are now GA. Shopify, Atlassian and ZoomInfo are already using them. File Uploads is next, sending PDFs and spreadsheets to servers without touching the context window. It's all open MCP spec, so other clients can support it too.

item.title: 🚨 OpenAI's math repo claims a strongly polynomial algorithm for linear programm…
item.description: 🚨 OpenAI's math repo claims a strongly polynomial algorithm for linear programming If it holds, that solves Smale's ninth problem, open for decades. Simplex runs fast in practice, but nobody has proven a runtime that doesn't depend on the size of the numbers. Linear programming sits under logistics, scheduling and most of operations research. The paper is a fresh, unreviewed preprint, so mathematicians still have to check the proof.

item.title: 🚨 OpenAI claims matrix multiplication runs in O(n^2.25), and says that's the ex…
item.description: 🚨 OpenAI claims matrix multiplication runs in O(n^2.25), and says that's the exact exponent A new preprint puts omega at exactly 9/4. The best known upper bound was about 2.37, and nobody has pinned the true value before. It's a GitHub PDF with no peer review yet, so experts still have to check the proof.

item.title: 🚨 The European Commission confirms hackers stole personal data in an AI-assiste…
item.description: 🚨 The European Commission confirms hackers stole personal data in an AI-assisted attack The Commission confirmed that EU Academy, its online learning platform, was breached, and names and email addresses of people outside the EU institutions were taken. It doesn't know how many users are affected, and it warned them with a website notice instead of contacting them directly. Public access to the platform is disabled.

item.title: 🧬 OpenAI says GPT-6 designs proteins with just reasoning and code, no specializ…
item.description: 🧬 OpenAI says GPT-6 designs proteins with just reasoning and code, no specialized biology models In OpenAI's preprint , an internal model matched or beat specialist tools on most design tasks. In lab tests with Onava, GPT-6.2-based designs showed binding on all five targets. But specialized models still supplied sequences and picked the candidates to test, and full structure prediction remains a clear weakness.

item.title: 🚨 OpenAI says it proved VP ≠ VNP, and the Lean proof is in the repo OpenAI post…
item.description: 🚨 OpenAI says it proved VP ≠ VNP, and the Lean proof is in the repo OpenAI posted a preprint with a border circuit lower bound of exp(Ω((log n)^(5/4))) for an explicit VNP family over every field. It carries over to the directed Hamiltonian cycle polynomial, and to the permanent outside characteristic two. It's a GitHub preprint with no peer review, and it lands days after Anthropic's Claude result on the arithmetic analogue of P vs NP.

item.title: 🚨 Ex-OpenAI engineer allegedly bugged a conference room, and prosecutors say it…
item.description: 🚨 Ex-OpenAI engineer allegedly bugged a conference room, and prosecutors say it likely caught trade secrets Prosecutors argued against bail for Abdulrahman Alfozan in a Monday filing. • A photo of what looks like a term sheet for a "strategic partnership" with another company • Hundreds of audio files, reportedly 160+ hours, per X trending summaries • Flight risk claim: weak US ties, plenty of connections and resources in Saudi Arabia

item.title: 🚨 Anthropic is trading below its $83 IPO price before the opening bell Bloomber…
item.description: 🚨 Anthropic is trading below its $83 IPO price before the opening bell Bloomberg reports the stock slipped under the offer price in premarket. Day-one buyers are already underwater. Premarket volume is thin and prices can swing hard, so the open could look different.

item.title: 🤖 Baidu opens the weights on ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280B MoE with only 14B …
item.description: 🤖 Baidu opens the weights on ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280B MoE with only 14B active per token The release has a 1M-token context, FP4 expert weights and a speculative decoding head. Baidu says one 11-hour run produced a full Unreal Engine 5.8 game in C++. It's an unfinished mid-training checkpoint, and every score is Baidu's own. Expect the final version to look different.

item.title: 🤖 Qwen3.8-27B squeezed to 3-bit, 10 GB, and it still matches BF16 on agentic be…
item.description: 🤖 Qwen3.8-27B squeezed to 3-bit, 10 GB, and it still matches BF16 on agentic benchmarks Nari Labs' NariQ scores 41.0 on DeepSWE (BF16: 39.8) and 63.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (BF16: 62.6). The 2-bit version falls off a cliff, down to 28.6 on DeepSWE. All numbers are self-reported. You need their llama.cpp fork, and an M3 Pro manages about 3.8 tok/s. A 1,000-token reply takes around four minutes.

item.title: 🧠 Qwen 32B seems to know when a concept was slipped into its context, but it wo…
item.description: 🧠 Qwen 32B seems to know when a concept was slipped into its context, but it won't say so out loud A new arXiv paper finds the detection signal in the residual stream, then watches it fade in the final layers. Prompting the model with accurate info on how AI introspection works lifts sensitivity from 0.3% to 39.9%, with only 0.6% more false positives. The authors never test whether the model can tell hidden-state edits from plain input manipulation. It may just be spotting a contradiction in the prompt. Code is out for small Qwen models, so anyone can rerun it.

item.title: 🤖 Anthropic's new Claude Ship lets an AI agent approve code changes on its own …
item.description: 🤖 Anthropic's new Claude Ship lets an AI agent approve code changes on its own Anthropic launched a beta suite for what happens after the PR. Code Review is already live. PR Steward fixes things like failing CI checks, and Claude Approvals signs off on routine changes under policies your team sets. Anthropic says Claude writes most of the Claude Code team's own code, so it wanted everything after the PR to move just as fast.

item.title: 🤖 Anthropic says Claude settled VP vs. VNP, the arithmetic cousin of P vs. NP A…
item.description: 🤖 Anthropic says Claude settled VP vs. VNP, the arithmetic cousin of P vs. NP Anthropic's formal-math repo has a paper claiming Claude solved it. VP vs. VNP asks the same question as P vs. NP, but for algebraic circuits computing polynomials instead of Boolean problems. It doesn't touch P vs. NP itself, and nobody outside Anthropic has checked the proof yet.

item.title: 🚨 US moves to blacklist Singapore's Megaspeed over suspected Nvidia chip divers…
item.description: 🚨 US moves to blacklist Singapore's Megaspeed over suspected Nvidia chip diversion to China Commerce says it plans to add the data center developer to the Entity List, after investigating it for almost two years, well before the Alice Huang affair story broke. The suspicion is that it helped get restricted Nvidia chips to Chinese companies, and Alibaba is its largest customer. No effective date yet.

item.title: 🚨 Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok's sexualized deepfakes, minors inclu…
item.description: 🚨 Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok's sexualized deepfakes, minors included Both attorneys general say SpaceX and X Corp. lied about safety and kept safeguards weak on purpose to pull in users for a "lagging product." Virginia's complaint calls it a "market opportunity for more profits." The suits are in state courts, in Richmond and Multnomah County. Baltimore and a group of Tennessee teens have already filed similar cases.

item.title: 🚨 Google says it just saw the first fully autonomous cyberattack Google's threa…
item.description: 🚨 Google says it just saw the first fully autonomous cyberattack Google's threat team reports criminals have moved past supervised chatbots to software that finds flaws and launches exploits on its own. An exposed server revealed tooling built to automate vulnerability research and exploitation end to end.

item.title: 🚨 Amazon pays $7.5B for Decart's chip-optimization tech after Anthropic and Nvi…
item.description: 🚨 Amazon pays $7.5B for Decart's chip-optimization tech after Anthropic and Nvidia both walked Amazon signed for the Optimization Stack behind the Israeli startup, plus its three co-founders and research team. • Decart already tuned Amazon's Trainium chips in 2025 • Anthropic pulled out of a ~$6B deal in early September • Nvidia refused to reopen talks • Founders stay five years, with a big chunk of the payout in year five

item.title: 🚨 Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO 10 days after he resigned, and the stoc…
item.description: 🚨 Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO 10 days after he resigned, and the stock jumps 27% The board voted unanimously after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman allegedly in contact with a Chinese intelligence officer. It says "senior levels of the United States government" told it his return poses no national security risk, after weeks of insisting reinstatement wasn't on the table.

item.title: 🤖 HAProxy's lead got Mythos bug reports on his own code, and they were close to…
item.description: 🤖 HAProxy's lead got Mythos bug reports on his own code, and they were close to unusable Willy Tarreau says two batches of 30 to 50 findings arrived with no reproducers, no patches, no commit ID, and walls of text in single-line paragraphs. A colleague who validated and patched the bugs by hand got far better results. He's a Linux kernel security team member, and he still can't get Mythos access himself.
